scope_targets: 技術経営専門職学位課程

rules.annotation_note: Human-reviewed necessary-but-not-sufficient age criterion for applicants using the named individual eligibility review route. Confirmed means only that this atomic age criterion applies; it does not establish review approval or route eligibility.

reviewed_coverage_statement: Covers reviewed atomic conditions for direct education paths (1)-(8), including only the completion cutoffs and contact actions explicitly supported by the fixed official PDF, plus the existing named age criterion.
limitation_statement: Uses exactly one academic credential; official recognition or designation must be supplied as confirmed evidence. It does not cover individual review paths (9)-(11) as a whole, school final verification, overall eligibility, admission, or recommendations.
